description: The c11Tests host step in .github/workflows/ci.yml (~line 227) is continue-on-error: true, and main carries 44 pre-existing failing host tests. A new host-test regression therefore never turns CI red. During C11-248 phase 3 the rename orchestrator had to diff the failure list per PR by hand (zero new failures across #482/#483/#484). Fix: triage the 44 (fix, or quarantine with a named skip list and a ticket each), then drop continue-on-error so the step gates. Interim option: a CI step that fails when the failure set grows versus a checked-in baseline. Related: C11-109 (skipped 7 flaky classes), C11-27 (logic/host split).
title: CI: make the c11Tests host step gating again (44 failing tests, regressions invisible)
